question:
Create a new KiCad project named b21 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a CR2032-powered replacement LED-watch module with an MSP430FR2433IRGET, a 32.768 kHz crystal, an AS1115-BQFT driver and the supplied HP-5082-7414 four-digit common-cathode display. Connect segments by name and digits CC1-CC4 to DIG0-DIG3. Use the supplied Elektronika symbols and footprints for the display, battery holder and MCU.
Firmware uses P1.2/P1.3 for SDA/SCL with 10k pull-ups and P1.0, P1.1, P1.4, P1.5, P1.6 for five separate button contacts. These contacts are single plated pads for external case buttons, not complete two-terminal switches on this board. Include the 40k display-current setting resistor and crystal load capacitors. The 1x4 eZ-FET header is programming power, TEST/SBWTCK, RESET/SBWTDIO, GND; isolate its power feed from the coin cell with a 1N4148 diode.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (Elektronika.kicad_sym) and footprint library (Elektronika.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.

The partial schematic includes the MCU, battery holder, crystal, button pads, pull-ups and programming header. It assumes grounded case-button contacts with MCU internal pull-ups and a 12.5 pF crystal. The battery-side isolation diode prevents programmer power from charging the cell, but its voltage drop needs a supply-margin check.
